Ram Temple Donation Theft Allegations Lead to Trust Meeting and Investigations

Allegations of theft and embezzlement from the Ram Temple donation box have surfaced, prompting a meeting of the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust to discuss potential resignations and preliminary investigation reports. The police have obtained court permission to question several accused individuals, while a trust member has backed government action and called for capital punishment. Opposition leaders have also been drawn into the controversy, with the VHP asking authorities to question them.
